one_liner: Visual discovery engine and social media platform for sharing and discovering ideas.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 for user authentication and generating access tokens via the Pinterest REST API.
verdict_reason: Pinterest provides a robust public REST API (v5) with standard OAuth 2.0 authentication and comprehensive developer documentation.

extras.rate_limit_note: Rate limits apply per application and user token.

evidence.quote: On the collection site, select OAuth under Pinterest REST API (latest) in the left navigation panel. Then select Generate access token.
